kicker: For the seed you're still waiting on
truth: You planted it crying and you're still waiting for the harvest to show.
accent: still waiting for the harvest to show
prayer: Lord, I planted this in tears and some days it feels like nothing grew. Remind me that You never forget what obedience buries in the dark, and that joy is still coming for me. In Jesus' name, amen.

verse.text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

save: Save this for the thing you planted and are still waiting on
